_comment: Hand-authored judgments joined by resource-census.mjs. Precedence: override (file + symbol/kind/enclosing/anchorIncludes; most specific wins) > fileDefault. Every census resource must match a rule; every rule must match a resource. Values: currentUsers subset of page|focus|flow|narrate|shell; proposedOwner one of page|focus|flow|narrate|shell|infrastructure-port|per-mode (per-mode requires privateCopiesFor).

src/hooks/useReadingModeInstance.ts.rationale: Central factory bridge replaced by mode-local factories; each mode keeps its own callback refs.

src/hooks/useDocumentLifecycle.ts.rationale: Document load/session statistics stay in the shell.

src/hooks/usePersistentReadingAnchor.ts.rationale: One persistent anchor shared by all modes today; each ModeState owns its anchor and hands off by value; the persistence port accepts active-owner values only.

src/modes/FocusMode.ts.rationale: FocusMode pacing timer/state (the active Focus clock in ReaderContainer).

src/reader/modes/FocusModeAdapter.ts.rationale: Adapter class fields; adapter has no production importer (tests only).
src/reader/modes/FocusModeAdapter.ts.reason: Not wired into production; currentUsers empty by evidence (dependencies.json existingSitesNotReachableFromProductionEntry).

src/reader/modes/FlowModeAdapter.ts.rationale: Adapter class fields; adapter has no production importer (tests only).

src/reader/modes/NarrateModeAdapter.ts.rationale: Adapter class fields; adapter has no production importer (tests only).

src/hooks/useReader.ts.rationale: RSVP display state/pacing; ReaderContainer and StandaloneReader (App.tsx) each create an instance.

src/components/ReaderView.tsx.rationale: Focus RSVP view (overlay in ReaderContainer, full view in StandaloneReader).

src/components/PausedTextView.tsx.rationale: Paused text view rendered by ReaderView only.

src/utils/FlowScrollEngine.ts.rationale: FlowScrollEngine instance state/timers/listeners; engine only runs while readingMode==='flow' && flowPlaying.

src/utils/FlowCursorController.ts.rationale: Non-EPUB flow cursor; only importer PageReaderView is elided from the bundle.
src/utils/FlowCursorController.ts.reason: Dead in production; recommend retire rather than copy.

src/components/FlowText.tsx.rationale: Legacy flow text; only importer ScrollReaderView is dead.

src/components/PageReaderView.tsx.rationale: Legacy non-EPUB page view; ReaderContainer imports but never renders it (import elided).
src/components/PageReaderView.tsx.reason: Dead in production; recommend retire rather than copy into TextView.tsx.

src/components/ScrollReaderView.tsx.rationale: Legacy scroll reader; ReaderContainer imports but never renders it (import elided).

src/components/FoliatePageView.tsx.rationale: One FoliatePageView instance (one foliate-view element, DOM refs, layout caches) serves every mode today; spec item 7 gives each mode its own FoliateView.

src/utils/wordPositionIndex.ts.rationale: Single WordPositionIndex per FoliatePageView today; each mode's FoliateView constructs its own.

src/utils/foliateAnchorNavigation.ts.rationale: Retry delay inside jumpFoliateToWordAnchor, called from page onLoad restore and every mode's jump-back.

src/utils/foliateWordWrapping.ts.rationale: Batch-yield timer inside wrapWordsInSpans (section load in every mode; Narrate restamp).

src/utils/foliateHelpers.ts.rationale: BLOCK_TAGS is a never-mutated module Set; each mode's helper copy holds its own.

src/hooks/useFoliateSync.ts.rationale: Browse-away polling runs in every mode against the shared Foliate view.

src/hooks/useNarrationSync.ts.rationale: TTS settings bridge refs (voice/rate/engine) feed only the narration hook.

src/hooks/useKeyboardShortcuts.ts.rationale: Library/global keyboard hooks in the same file; not reader-mode behavior.

src/reader/useReaderModeOrchestrator.ts.rationale: Router: the useReaderMode() instance it creates is the shared ref bag every mode transition goes through.

src/hooks/useEinkController.ts.rationale: E-ink refresh state; fed by page relocate, Flow progress and Focus view refresh button.

src/utils/narrateDiagnostics.ts.rationale: Process-global diagnostic ring written by FoliatePageView (every mode), ReaderContainer and TTS.
src/utils/narrateDiagnostics.ts.reason: Diagnostics is not a named port category in spec item 5; module-level mutable state would violate 'no module singleton state' unless explicitly allowed.
